verdict.rationale: Wrike's developer portal names webhooks as part of its platform, so the product appears to offer outbound callbacks itself. It is only a single passing marketing mention, with no documentation of how to register webhooks or which events are available. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration endpoint, list of subscribable event types, payload format and delivery/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Deploy to users worldwide with confidence thanks to OAuth 2.0 authentication, webhooks, and rate-limit-friendly design.
